nav_note: Every theme has a real global top header (site title/logo + primary nav + CTA). side-rail/overlay/split describe the primary-nav arrangement on top of that header, never a replacement.
image_note: cutout-break-frame = transparent-background WebP objects that overlap frames, text or colour fields (破格). real-photography = photorealistic photography-style images generated with Grok Build (scripts/grok-image.sh), prompted with a photo direction (lens, lighting, grain) and colour-graded toward the theme main colour; no stock fetching. For real-photography rows the illustration column holds a photo direction (enums.photo_direction) instead of an illustration style.

history.note: v1.1.0 (2026-10-15, issues #67 and #79): asymmetric 12-column home read left to right with a blank left margin column for section numbers (asymmetric masonry hat shelf of three unequal columns); vertical type only as title accents. Header H11 = formal top header: small hanging koubai tag + wordmark top left, horizontal numbered menu, account + cart (never fixed, no side rail). Hero = large horizontal headline beside a framed etching on an edo-murasaki #745399 field; break-frame cut-out hat over the matcha #C5C56A band edge; ai indigo #165E83 fit band; F4 purple letter band over a shikon #2B1E3A base. Accent koubai #E16B8C (deep #A8325A for numerals on washi); no vermilion/orange, no tetsukon + yamabuki.
